1.explanation:
• Tabs/Tabs.mdx  – The root Tabs documentation shows how the Line and Contained variants are rendered, including examples of icon-only usage. We need to update this to reflect the new size prop (default vs. large) and the required height/padding changes.  

• Tab/Tab.mdx  – Defines the individual Tab item’s props and styling. Adding a size prop at the Tabs level will need co-ordination here to adjust the Tab’s padding/height when only icons are present.  

• TabContent/TabContent.mdx  – Controls how the tab panel content is anchored and sized within the overall Tabs container. Ensuring that the container grows from 40px to 48px correctly when “large” is set requires reviewing this file as well.  

Together, these three files cover the API surface (props) and styling examples required to understand the current default behavior and to reproduce and document the new large-size option for icon-only Tabs.
1.bug_scenario:
The bug applies to the “icon-only” Tabs variant (both the Line tabs and the ContainedTabs). In the provided screenshot we see two horizontal tab bars, each showing only icons (Home, Bookmark, Pin):

– The first (default) is 40px tall, with 16px of horizontal padding around each icon.  
– The second (large) should be 48px tall, with 20px of horizontal padding around each icon.  

Currently there is no “size” prop exposed on the icon-only Tabs/ContainedTabs variants to switch between these two sizing modes.
